gameName: Eclipse: New Dawn for the Galaxy

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi)

modules.name: Alien species
modules.note: Recommended from the second game on.

modules.name: Rise of the Ancients
modules.note: Modular: turn on the parts you want. Planta and Descendants are not recommended for 7-9 players.

modules.name: RotA: Ancient Hives and Warp Portals

steps.text: Ship Part tiles and the Round marker on the Supply board
Shuffle the Technology tiles in a bag; draw {n} onto the Research tracks, stacking matching tiles
Rare Technology tiles into the bag too; any drawn go beside the Supply and don't count toward the draw
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.4

steps.text: 7-9 players: add the 18 Extra Technology tiles to the bag and the Extra Reputation tiles to theirs
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.12

steps.text: {n} random Development tiles beside the Supply; box the rest
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.5

steps.text: Reputation tiles in the other bag
Discovery tiles shuffled facedown on their spot; Ancient Ships, Orbitals and Monoliths, Damage cubes and the Traitor card on the board
Galactic Center in the middle: a facedown Discovery tile and the Defense System tile on it
Galactic Center: a facedown Discovery tile with the Ancient Dreadnought (random side) instead of the Defense System
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.6

steps.text: Shuffle the Ancient Hive and/or Warp Sector hexes into the Middle and Outer stacks before building them
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.7-8

steps.text: Sector hexes facedown in 3 stacks: all Inner (I), all Middle (II), {n} random Outer (III)
7-9 players: lay the Inner and Middle hexes facedown in rings around the Center to find the start spots
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.12

steps.text: A random Ancient Homeworld on each Homeworld spot of the diagram, with a facedown Discovery tile and an Ancient Cruiser on it
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.6

steps.text: Starting Player marker to whoever has spent the least time on Terra
With aliens: from the starting player's right, counterclockwise, each picks a species (choosing Terrans removes one alien species)
From the starting player clockwise: take a start hex and its Player Board; place it on the nearest start spot two hexes from the Center
In the same order place your species' start hex on the nearest start spot two hexes from the Center
7-9 players: from the starting player's right, counterclockwise, each picks a species and places it on the next start spot, at least one wormhole facing a Middle hex
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.12

steps.text: Box the unused start hexes and boards
All Ships, Ambassadors, discs and cubes of your colour, 3 Colony Ships (Planta: 4) and a Summary card (Action side up)
An Influence Disc on every circle of the Influence track (Eridani: leave the 2 rightmost empty)
A Population cube on every square of the 3 Population tracks except the lighter rightmost one
Storage markers: Money 2, Science 3, Materials 3 (aliens: their species' values)
7-9 players: each player removes 1 Population cube from a track of their choice
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.12

steps.text: On your start hex: 1 Interceptor (Orion: a Cruiser), a cube on each normal Population square from its track, 1 Influence Disc from your track
Eridani Empire
details: Start: 26 Money, 2 Science, 4 Materials; hex 222; Gauss Shield, Fusion Drive, Plasma Cannon
Reputation: draws 2 random Reputation tiles at the start
Influence: 2 fewer discs
Trade: 3:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Hydran Progress
details: Start: 2 Money, 5 Science, 2 Materials; hex 224; Advanced Labs
Setup: an extra cube on the Advanced Science square of the start hex
Research: may buy 2 Technologies per action
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Planta
details: Start: 4 Money, 4 Science, 4 Materials; hex 226; Starbase; 4 Colony Ships
Explore: may explore 2 hexes per action
Fragile: enemy Ships destroy their Population cubes after combat
Growth: 1 extra VP per controlled hex at game end
Trade: 3:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Descendants of Draco
details: Start: 2 Money, 4 Science, 3 Materials; hex 228
Explore: turn 2 hexes and keep one, or discard both
Ancients: 1 VP per Ancient Ship left on the board at game end
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Mechanema
details: Start: 3 Money, 3 Science, 3 Materials; hex 230; Positron Computer
Upgrade: up to 3 Ship Part tiles per action
Build: up to 3 Ships or Structures per action, at lower cost
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Orion Hegemony
details: Start: 3 Money, 3 Science, 5 Materials; hex 232; Neutron Bombs, Gauss Shield; a Cruiser instead of an Interceptor
Trade: 4:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Keepers, Sentinels or Wardens of Magellan
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.14
details: Start: hex 233, 235 or 237; Fusion Source
Revelation: the first time any track reaches 4 Technologies, take a free Discovery tile
Colony Ships: Influence may flip 1 Colony Ship faceup; unused ones can be flipped for 1 free Resource each
Relics: 1 VP per Discovery tile discarded or used as a Ship Part

steps.text: The Exiles
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.14
details: Start: hex 234 with an Orbital; Cloaking Device, Orbital
Orbital ships: Orbitals with your cube are Ships with their own blueprint; no Starbases
Score: 1 VP per Orbital with your cube

steps.text: Rho Indi Syndicate
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.15
details: Start: hex 236 with 2 Interceptors; Starbase, Gauss Shield
Move: up to 4 Ship activations
Pillage: after drawing Reputation tiles, take Money equal to the tiles drawn minus 1
Trade: Money 3:2, others 3:1

steps.text: Enlightened of Lyra
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.15
details: Start: hex 238; Distortion Shield
Shrines: at the start of Upkeep build 1 Shrine next to a matching planet in a hex you control; a full set of 3 gives its bonus tile

steps.text: Alliances (4+ players): two players with Diplomatic Relations may found one; allies can't attack each other and fight together
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.10

steps.text: End of Cleanup: roll for each Ancient Hive and move one Ancient Ship out of it
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.7

steps.text: 7-9 players: Cleanup draws {n} new Technology tiles
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.13

steps.text: Simultaneous play: Primary Action marker to the starting player, Secondary to the player opposite; only Primary may Research
steps.ref: Eclipse: Rise of the Ancients rulebook (Lautapelit.fi) p.13

steps.text: Move: Terrans make 3 Ship movements, every alien species only 2
Upkeep: pay the Money shown on the leftmost empty Influence circle
Ships, cubes, discs and tiles are limited; Ship Parts, Orbitals and Damage cubes are not
The starting player takes the first action
